headline: A 2019 executive order creates a federal task force on cases of missing and murdered American Indians and Alaska Natives.
what_it_does: This order sets up a federal task force focused on American Indians and Alaska Natives who go missing or are murdered. No summary was provided, so details such as who leads the task force, its exact duties, and its deadlines cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.how: The task force is focused on cases where members of these communities go missing or are killed.
Tribes may be involved in or affected by the task force's work on these cases, though the title does not say how.
Federal officials would staff or take part in the new task force.
